reason: The query parameter from getQueryString() is extracted, URL-decoded, and passed through doSomething() to variable 'bar', which is then concatenated into the SQL string. The guard ((500 / 42) + num > 200) is always true (11 + 196 = 207 > 200), so user input reaches the SQL sink without effective neutralization.
